Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: credits and support for vendor bake-off

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile on your hosted endpoints looked very promising compared to the other vendors. We're running a vendor bake-off next week (May 24–31) to validate generation quality and cost under our real workload.

Procurement has asked for any available promotional support (credits) and a short escalation path / on-call window while we test. Specifically:
- 2 weeks of eval access (24–31 May)
- ~400k token credit estimate (we can tighten numbers once we share traces)
- 2 dedicated 1-hour shadow sessions with an engineer during peak runs

I've attached a short RFP summary. Can Redwood commit to an allocation or trial top-up and a named SE during the window? If so, procurement can fast-track a minimal NDA + SOW.

Appreciate a quick yes/no today if possible — we're trying to finalize the bake-off roster.

Best,
Lisa
Head of Platform Integrations
DataStack Inc.

- DataStack_RFP_Summary.pdf

Proposal (internal request attached):
- 400k token credit allocated to your account, valid 24–31 May
- Two 1-hour shadow sessions with an SE (Ben listed below) during peak runs

Folks — forwarding Lisa's request. Quick internal summary and ask below.

Summary: DataStack is a mid-market infra shop evaluating three vendors; they want a timeboxed credit allocation (~400k tokens) plus two SE shadow sessions. Likely value: if we win, expansion includes a Dedicated onboarding opportunity next quarter.

My recommendation: approve 400k trial credit + SE support (Ben: I'll cover one session and schedule a second with Monica). Also propose we include a lightweight performance checklist (SOW) and limit credit usage to generation endpoints. We should require a minimal signature (SOW) and mark the credit as non-refundable demo credit.

Approval request (for Aditya's signature path):
- Promo credit: 400k tokens (one-off)
- SOW: minimal, DocuSign link will be generated
- Named SE support: Ben (here) + Monica as backup
- Timebox: 24–31 May 2026
- Success criteria: run our standard fairness/latency prompts and provide token consumption report

If we'd like to be conservative, we can propose 300k tokens + option to add more after a short checkpoint. What do you want me to submit in the approval doc?

On costs: 400k tokens at our promo rate is roughly $X (internal calc in attached sheet).

-- Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
